title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Following a cholera outbreak, this project provided rapid assistance to cholera affected communities by upskilling health professionals, providing medical supplies and promoting cholera prevention awareness in Janamora, West Belesa woredas and Gondar town, Amhara, Ethiopia. Cholera case management training was provided to health professionals from hospitals, health centres and health offices and essential medication and medical supplies were provided where there were gaps, including water treatment chemicals to manage estimated 500 cholera cases in 25 target health facilities. . OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Contribute to immediate food and other essential commodities as well as reducing the risk of severe disease outbreak among fire affected persons.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME:
